title: Cross-sectional rank-IC screen (literature review 2026-10-21, candidates 1 and 2): short-horizon / BTC-residual momentum, illiquidity, realized variance and signed jumps, ranked across the walk-forward pairs at daily-to-weekly horizons
label: SCREEN, PROVISIONAL -- no training, no backtest; a PASS only licenses a pre-registered backtest arm. One era (2023-26), halves are the persistence test.
data: freqtrade 15m feathers (user_data/data/binance); daily close = last 15m close of the UTC day; bars with volume == 0 excluded from the variance and illiquidity sums

resmom_7d.def: sum over the last 7 days of (r_i - beta_i r_BTC), daily log returns, beta_i = OLS slope over the trailing 60 daily returns ending at t

amihud_14d.def: mean over the last 14 days of |r_15m| / (close*volume) per 15m bar (illiquidity)

rv_7d.def: sum of squared 15m log returns over the last 7 days

rs_up_7d.def: sum of squared POSITIVE 15m log returns over the last 7 days

mom_90d.def: log close_t / close_{t-90d} -- the live MomentumRegimeBasket's ranking (MOM_LOOKBACK 90); BASELINE, reported, no verdict

metric: Spearman rank IC across pairs on day t (>= 6 pairs with signal and target), sampled every h days from the first day of each half (non-overlapping targets); t = mean/sd*sqrt(n) over those days, per half and pooled

rule.PASS: for a signal x horizon: mean IC has the declared sign in BOTH halves, pooled |t| >= 3.0 and |t| >= 1.5 in each half
rule.multiple_testing: 10 signals x 3 horizons = 30 tests; the t >= 3 bar is the guard (Bonferroni 0.05/30 ~ t 3.1 two-sided: treat 3.0-3.1 as borderline)

descriptive: per signal x horizon, per half: long the top 3 by signal (sign-adjusted), equal weight, rebalanced every h days, 15 bp per unit of one-way turnover (30 bp round trip), minus the equal-weight all-pair return over the same periods; gross and net. No rule.
seen_before: the live basket (90d top-3) runs on a broad universe, not these pairs; no IC of any listed signal on these pairs has been computed
feature 038 cross-asset forecasts (15m, N <= 96 bars) FAIL
dynamic lookback rejected (memory) -- lookbacks here are fixed
